papers.title: AquaCrop modeling to explore optimal irrigation of winter wheat for improving grain yield and water productivity
papers.primary_goal: Determine winter-wheat irrigation schedules that improve grain yield and water productivity under varying weather conditions.
papers.task_relation: The paper directly optimizes wheat irrigation using AquaCrop and weather records. science_relevance.definition: A task is important to science when it addresses a substantive scientific or real-world problem, and a cited research paper's main objective is to solve that problem or advance understanding of it. The evidence must explain why the problem matters and how the local task represents it. Using a task to evaluate an agent, framework, or general-purpose model, or citing only a benchmark, dataset, or tool, does not establish scientific importance.
